en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a street corner with a large corner building in ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century Central European style (steep tiled roofs, half‑timbered upper floor, decorative gables). The ground floor hosts a café; awnings and signage are visible, and the entrance is reached by a short stairway. A wrought-iron gate on the left bears a sign for a garden attached to the café. To the right runs a tram line with an electric streetcar numbered 1057 and overhead wires. People in light clothing walk along the street. Behind the buildings are tree‑covered hills, suggesting a small city or town in a hilly region.
